MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The NETGEAR extender felt relevant because I previously chose an EX2700 and have since added Echo and Fire TV devices; I would consider an upgrade after checking compatibility with my router.",
    "The HDMI cable connects naturally to my TV, Blu-ray and streaming purchases, although I would only choose it if I needed a 15-foot cable."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Galaxy Tab protector, older Kindle Fire case and satellite radio kit require specific devices that my history does not establish I own.",
    "The foldable keyboard does not fit a current need after my recent full-size multi-device keyboard purchase, and the older HP laptop offers no clear reason to replace my existing setup.",
    "The tablet floor stand and bookshelf speaker stands do not serve the Echo Show and Echo speakers I have been buying; their intended devices matter more than their shared purpose as stands."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My Mac-compatible accessories seemed to be taken as evidence that I need iPhone or iPad accessories, but they do not establish ownership of those devices.",
    "My Fire TV and Echo purchases seemed to lead to accessories for other tablets and audio equipment, even though those products have different compatibility requirements."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent Echo, Echo Show and Fire TV purchases make useful additions to that connected setup more relevant to me than accessories for unrelated devices.",
    "My recent keyboard and Echo Show stand choices suggest those needs may already be covered; another keyboard or stand needs a distinct purpose.",
    "A plausible accessory still needs a practical reason to buy it now, such as a confirmed connection need, suitable cable length or compatible upgrade."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my home electronics setup, but often assumed device ownership and accessory needs that my purchases do not support."
}
